lead: Pinarayi Vijayan is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 21 March 1936 in Pinarayi.
As of 2026, he is 90 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Kerala and Member of the 14th Kerala Legislative Assembly.
Below you will find a verified overview of Pinarayi Vijayan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Pinarayi Vijayan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Kerala (2016–present), Member of the 14th Kerala Legislative Assembly (2016–2021), Member of the 15th Kerala Legislative Assembly (2021–present) and Member of the 16th Kerala Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with Communist Party of India (Marxist).
